messages:
maria: quick hit  can we add a 'canary cost forecast' to the rollout page? users keep reporting that early runs look 3-5x more expensive because caches aren't warmed.

jake: this is a common ask. propose we show: measured cost (actual billed tokens) + a projected steady-state cost after cache warmup. small visual: two lines + a shaded uncertainty band.

sarah: important to call out this is an estimate. billing must stay strictly tied to measured tokens. projection = advisory only.

maria: agreed. UX idea: include a small explainer pill that lists assumptions (sample rate, avg seq len, prefix reuse). also a toggle: [Measured | Projected | Both]. default Both.

tom: we already emit per-invocation attrs: route_id, model_sku, tokens_in/out, cache_hit. missing piece is aggregated prefix reuse by route over time. we'll need a cheap agg job.
jake: could we approximate server-side but compute projection client-side from sampled telemetry? sliding window hit% -> extrapolate steady state. fastest path to prototype.
sarah: that can work for beta. must show confidence band and sample rate in the tooltip: "based on 1-in-20 sampled traces".
maria: also the projection needs to be SKU-aware. fallback to different quantized model will change hit semantics. show per-SKU lines or limit projection to the active SKU.
tom: agree. also add infra surcharge to per-token pricing formula. sample pricing calc: avg_tokens * model_unit_price + infra_pct. link to pricing table.
jake: rough schema we can use for the console card (flattened): route_id, model_sku, avg_seq_len, avg_tokens_per_invocation, avg_token_cost, cache_hit_pct, projected_cost_per_hour. we'll derive those from time buckets.
maria: ops question  will this be behind a feature flag? we shouldn't surface noisy projections externally until stable.
ops-bot: feature-flag created: ff/canary-cost-forecast-2026. owner: @maria. scope: internal beta.
sarah: also add an invoice opt-out so projections don't accidentally appear on billing exports. billing team prefers raw numbers only.
tom: implementation checklist: 1) 1m precomputed hit-rate buckets per route+sku (sampled), 2) projection service (JS fallback), 3) rollout UI card + toggle + confidence band, 4) docs + help copy + CSV download on drilldown.
jake: perf note: computing sliding windows at request time for routes with millions of invocations is expensive. precompute and store compressed PBs or timeseries. sampling greatly reduces storage.
maria: plan: I'll mock the UI with a stub endpoint returning projected curves. pairing session with @tom next Wed to estimate infra cost.
sarah: suggested tooltip copy: "Projected cost assumes stable request mix and cache reuse; actual billed amount is based on measured tokens. Use for comparisons and canary decisions, not invoices"
maria: tagging follow-ups: @jake for pricing calc, @tom for telemetry agg, @sarah for billing/UX wording.
jake: tiny polish: add a link from the canary card to the per-route cost breakdown so teams can drill into token histograms and sample prompts.
maria: +1. downloadable CSV for audits would be great. thanks all :thumbsup:

ops-bot: deploy-notice: staging rollout of ff/canary-cost-forecast-2026 scheduled 2026-03-02 04:00 UTC.
